definitions.explanation: A point where a road branches into two or more paths.
A decisive moment in life or a situation where an important choice must be made.

examples.japanese: {岐路|きろ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{立|た}ち{止|ど}まった→立ち止まる：04636_tachidomaru⟧。
examples.english: I stopped at the fork in the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{岐路|きろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かれている→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: The road splits at a fork.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{岐路|きろ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose the right path at the fork in the mountain trail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{岐路|きろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: To stand at a crossroads in life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧、⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な{岐路|きろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}たされて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The company now finds itself at a critical juncture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧、⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{岐路|きろ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{悩|なや}んでいる→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧。
examples.english: I'm agonizing at a crossroads in life over whether to change jobs.

notes:
Literally a place where a road branches. Most commonly used figuratively to describe a critical decision point in life, career, or events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{岐路|きろ} — crossroads in life
- {岐路|きろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ — to stand at a crossroads
- {岐路|きろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}たされる — to be placed at a crossroads
- ⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な{岐路|きろ} — a critical juncture

USAGE:
The figurative sense (sense 2) is far more common than the literal one. The phrase ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{岐路|きろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ is a set expression frequently used when discussing major life decisions.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{分岐点|ぶんきてん}→分岐点：09388_bunkiten⟧ — branching point (more technical or analytical)
- ⟦{分|わ}かれ{道|みち}→分かれ道：11753_wakaremichi⟧ — forked road (more literal, everyday)
